tickets.text: Add to would_change: elder_5d [7, 7, 7, 10, 10] is a summer plateau, not a transition (C20, C4); buying is permitted (elder >= 7, C3) but not timed. The pullback into the rising 20-day average is the Elder entry (C10), and a print of elder <= 1 at that pullback forbids the buy (C3).
